FIRST SUPPLEMENTAL INDENTURE dated as of May 1, 2026 to the Indenture dated as of February 10, 2026, among Northfield Components Corp., as Issuer, the Guarantors party hereto and Granite Trust Company, as Trustee, governing the 7.250% Senior Notes due 2031.

SECTION 1. Amendments . Section 4.09(c) of the Indenture is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: (c) Indebtedness in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed $75,000,000 at any time outstanding.

SECTION 2. Effectiveness . This Supplemental Indenture shall become effective on May 1, 2026, upon the execution hereof by the Issuer and the Trustee following receipt of the consent of the Holders of a majority in principal amount of the outstanding Notes.
